item: Row 336 and row 342: a backup checksum read stops at the size the list gives
summary: one bounded read (bounded_hash.sha256_read) hashes every file a backup manifest lists: a file larger than the size listed is a mismatch, refused by fstat before any read, and one that grows during the read is cut after at most one byte past the size; the volume-set verify, the parity check and rebuild check and the pool reuse (row 336) and the folder-backup verify on both paths (row 342) all pass it; an entry with no whole-number size is a mismatch, never an unbounded read, since the size sits in the same manifest as the volumes and every writer has recorded it since the first build; no other acceptance rule changed.
